lines.before: A feature, fix or triage sweep's Swarm Contract (also written as data) is approved by the pre-pr-sweep skill's `approve.mjs`, never an agent: same contract, same answer, no tokens. It approves only when the tier's and modifiers' roles are there, each role has its own question (no near-copies), context, finding shape and budget, and count and budgets fit the tier's caps; else the owner decides, told why. First push and launch gate always go to the owner. Each decision and outcome (tokens, findings, real, repeated) is logged; it pauses after tokens 25% over budget, a third of findings repeated, a bug escaping a passed sweep, or every 10 approvals (the trial review), and only the owner resumes it. Why: a routine sweep need not wait; the log shows when it drifts.
